# Mermaid Tiny

@mermaid-js/tiny 12.2.0, distributed under the MIT License in LICENSE.
Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mermaid-js/tiny/v/12.2.0
Project: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid
Usage: https://mermaid.js.org/config/usage.html

The local bundle renders the existing sequence diagrams and flowcharts. It is loaded only on pages containing Mermaid definitions. No visitor request is sent to a CDN.
